reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 7, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: In 1695, what digit is in the ones place?
What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 3250?
What is the place value of the digit 5 in 9105?
What is the place value of the digit 5 in 5210?
What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 4725?
What number do the blocks show?
What place is the digit 3 in, in the number 8235? The answer is tens.. True or False?
Use base-10 blocks to show the number 2385.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: All three named sub-skills are directly tested: place-name lookup ('What place is the digit 5 in, in the number 3250?' -> tens, seed 43), value lookup ('What is the place value of the digit 5 in 5210?' -> 5000, seed 45), and digit-given-place lookup ('In 1695, what digit is in the ones place?' -> 5, seed 42).

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Ones (42, 44, 46), tens (43, 51) and thousands (45) positions are all exercised across the 8 seeds, but not one sample, including the new block-based seeds 50 and 88, asks specifically about the hundreds digit, even though every 4-digit number shown has one.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Most stems are short and clear, but seed 51's 'What place is the digit 3 in, in the number 8235? The answer is tens.. True or False?' has a stray double period after 'tens' that reads as a rendering glitch and could confuse a grade 3 reader about the claim being evaluated.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The widened packet adds genuine breadth beyond numeral questions: a pictorial base-10-block reading task (seed 50, 'What number do the blocks show?') and a block-building production task (seed 88, 'Use base-10 blocks to show the number 2385.'), alongside mcq, cloze, and true_false formats.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample, including the two block-based items, stays within genuine 4-digit numbers (1695 through 9105) and never invokes a 5-digit or ten-thousands concept beyond this competency's explicit 4-digit scope.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The 4-digit numbers sampled (1695 to 9105) and their place values (ones through thousands, up to 5000 at seed 45) correctly match the '4-digit number' ceiling the competency text states.
